items.title: AI推論供應鏈傳出提示詞外洩，OpenRouter停用3家供應商的服務
items.summary: 企業使用AI模型時，送出的提示詞可能經過第三方推論服務供應商處理，一旦供應商遭入侵，提示詞及其中的敏感資訊就可能外洩。工控資安業者Dragos最近公佈研究結果，指出研究團隊利用近200萬筆測試提示詞，發現至少3家AI推論服務供應商遭入侵，其中一起事件的攻擊者甚至取得AWS測試金鑰，並嘗試存取雲端服務。

items.title: AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace
items.summary: A new real-world test puts AI coding agents in a simulated developer job with colleagues, project boards, and incomplete handoffs, where they have to keep developing software on their own and reliably close open tickets in a messy daily workflow. Even Opus 5.5 and Astra fall far short, solving fewer than one in ten tasks completely. The models finish clear, standalone assignments quickly, but they lose track as autonomous developers. The article AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 一項全新的現實世界測試將AI編程代理置於模擬的開發者職位中，身邊有同事、專案看板和不完整的交接內容，它們必須在混亂的日常工作流程中自行持續開發軟體，並可靠地關閉未解決的工單。甚至連 Opus 5.5 和 Astra 也遠遠不及格，完全解決的任務不到十分之一。這些模型能快速完成清晰、獨立的任務，但作為自主開發者時卻會迷失方向。

items.title: Perplexity's new Monitor API turns web search from a one-off query into a nonstop watchdog
items.summary: Perplexity is launching a Monitor API that searches the web on a schedule and alerts agents via webhook only when relevant changes occur. For Perplexity, the API is part of a broader strategy to stand out from an increasingly interchangeable chatbot business through developer tools. items.title: Lean and Mathlib community officially confirms Levent Alpöge's proof of the Riemann hypothesis is correct
items.summary: The Lean and Mathlib community has officially confirmed Levent Alpöge's proof of the Riemann hypothesis as correct. items.title: MiniMax 拿內部模型開刀密碼學：把紙面攻擊變成秒級實戰，NIST 競賽算法首次被真攻破
items.summary: MiniMax研究團隊用最新內部模型，對密碼學前沿方案開展系統性自動化密碼分析。模型發現一批此前未公開的算法構造弱點，並將原本停留在論文理論層面的攻擊方式，推進到秒級或分鐘級即可真實執行。這意味着過去需耗費大量人力時間、未必跑得通的攻擊，正被AI自動化顯著加速，密碼學安全評估面臨新變量。

items.title: 給 AI 發展劃一條“困惑度”紅線：OpenAI 首席科學家提議設行業門檻
items.summary: OpenAI首席科學家帕霍茨基提議，全行業共建AI開發標準，設置硬性安全門檻，企業須承諾滿足安全要求前不越線。方案以“困惑度”等技術指標劃定共同限制，用模型預測下一段文本的能力當安全考卷，防止能力逼近自我加速臨界點。彭博社11月23日報道。

items_ai.summary: A new real-world test puts AI coding agents in a simulated developer job with colleagues, project boards, and incomplete handoffs, where they have to keep developing software on their own and reliably close open tickets in a messy daily workflow. Even Opus 5.5 and Astra fall far short, solving fewer than one in ten tasks completely. The models finish clear, standalone assignments quickly, but they lose track as autonomous developers. The article AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace appeared first on The Decoder .

items_ai.title: MiniMax 拿內部模型開刀密碼學：把紙面攻擊變成秒級實戰，NIST 競賽算法首次被真攻破
items_ai.summary: MiniMax研究團隊用最新內部模型，對密碼學前沿方案開展系統性自動化密碼分析。模型發現一批此前未公開的算法構造弱點，並將原本停留在論文理論層面的攻擊方式，推進到秒級或分鐘級即可真實執行。這意味着過去需耗費大量人力時間、未必跑得通的攻擊，正被AI自動化顯著加速，密碼學安全評估面臨新變量。
